dataset.name: split_mnist
dataset.source: MNIST IDX archives (as downloaded by polynomial_cl.class_incremental.mnist from storage.googleapis.com/cvdf-datasets/mnist/)
dataset.test_split: MNIST t10k (10000 examples); never used for model selection

projection.description: (x - 0.1307) / 0.3081, then the core's fixed orthonormal random projection (QR of a seeded Gaussian); not fitted to data. Fixed across all runs and algorithms.

evaluation.population: test examples of experience j, scored after experience i >= j
evaluation.prediction_rule: argmax over classes introduced through experience i only (future classes never compete)
